title: Track VIXEN's codegen kernel pin with kernel landings
body: The static _vixen_tracked_yeroket_kernel_sha stayed at a2b2d6b after kernel P692 merged at 8d68e983, so the live Undertow schema catalogue made appflow_check abort. This lane had to hand-bump the pin. Have landing or reconciliation update and validate VIXEN against the exact compatible Yeroket commit used by schema consumers so the pin cannot lag a kernel landing.

title: Make the Vulkan SDK glslang include lookup case-tolerant
body: The fresh vixen-wsl configure provisioned Linux headers under lowercase include/glslang while VIXEN checked Include/glslang, printing a fatal diagnostic. I had to add the documented local Include -> include symlink before native compilation. Probe both cases or use the SDK's actual include path so Linux builds do not need a manual filesystem workaround.

title: Classify CMake configure jobs separately from full builds in the box queue
body: A configure submitted as resource build waited over two minutes on the 17 GB class reservation despite no compile workload. I canceled it and reran the same configure as resource light, which completed. Add a documented configure admission profile so configure-only work is not queued as a full compile and workers do not need to retry under another resource class.

title: Default VIXEN FetchContent to a worktree-local cache
body: The lane setup required passing VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<worktree>/.tmp/fetch for each configure even though VIXEN knows its source and binary worktree. Make a per-worktree and per-generator FetchContent cache the default so isolated builds do not depend on a manually repeated environment variable.
